messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — High error rate on /v1/generate in us-west1. Impact: ~30% requests failing with 500s. Paging sam (on-call).

sam: acked. joining bridge. seeing alert in datadog too. starting mitigation checklist.

lee: joining. quick check — console shows model variant 'redwood-xl-quant-v2' active in us-west1. API response headers show model-id: redwood-xl-quant-v2a. that mismatch looks suspicious.

anita: copying logs from dataplane (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T10:14:02Z] req=abcd1234 model=redwood-xl-quant-v2a status=500 "kv cache miss panic"
[2026-03-15T10:14:03Z] req=abcd1235 model=redwood-xl-quant-v2a status=500 "unexpected dtype"
```

maria: console config push at 10:12:43 said success: "deploy redwood-xl-quant-v2 -> us-west1". can someone confirm control-plane deploy service logs?

jun: pulling control-plane deploy logs now. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:41Z] deploy-service: start rollout id=roll-7841 target=redwood-xl-quant-v2
[2026-03-15T10:12:42Z] deploy-service: push -> config-store ok
[2026-03-15T10:12:43Z] controlplane-propagator: queue propagation to dataplanes (region=us-west1)
[2026-03-15T10:12:44Z] controlplane-propagator: ack from agent=dp-agent-3 timeout=5s
[2026-03-15T10:12:49Z] controlplane-propagator: WARNING: agent dp-agent-2 did not ack
```

sam: hypothesis 1: partial propagation — some dataplane nodes still reading old model metadata or a different model folder, hence console shows intended state but API hits nodes with incompatible artifact (v2a).

lee: hypothesis 2: dual variant routing — smart routing logic may be routing by cache-locality to v2a instances; if v2a artifacts are corrupted or built with wrong quantization, they'd return 500.

anita: quick mitigation proposal: 1) add temporary route filter to route-all to dedicated fallback pool (redwood-fallback-small) 2) disable autopropagator 3) gather full index of nodes reporting model-id header.

maria: i can flip route to fallback. command: `rbctl route set --region us-west1 --route /v1/generate --pool redwood-fallback-small --reason "mitigate inc 1799002468"`

sam: do it. maria please announce when done. also add header-based sampling to log requests that still hit failing nodes: `X-Debug-Trace: inc-1799002468`

deploy-bot: deploy job started: route-change job id=chg-99222 by maria.

maria: route change applied at 10:18:12Z. traffic now 100% -> redwood-fallback-small. monitoring...

ops-bot: service check: /v1/generate error-rate now 2.1% (was 31.4%). latency increase +12ms.

sam: good. reduced customer impact. next: collect full traces for RCA. anita/jun — please dump agent heartbeats + model manifest from all us-west1 agents. include checksums.

jun: uploaded aggregated bundle to s3://redwood-incident-bundles/1799002468/agents.tgz (presigned link) — shared in thread DM. manifest excerpt:
```
agent dp-agent-1 model=redwood-xl-quant-v2 checksum=sha256:aaaa1111
agent dp-agent-2 model=redwood-xl-quant-v2a checksum=sha256:bbbb2222
agent dp-agent-3 model=redwood-xl-quant-v2 checksum=sha256:aaaa1111
```

lee: dp-agent-2 shows different checksum and model-id — confirms partial propagation or bad artifact staged on that node. dp-agent-2 logs show failed artifact download at 10:12:47 and retried to fallback folder.

anita: action: cordon dp-agent-2 from load-balancer and trigger artifact refresh. command I ran: `rbctl agent cordon dp-agent-2 && rbctl agent refresh-artifact dp-agent-2 --model redwood-xl-quant-v2` result: refresh started.

jun: after refresh, dp-agent-2 checksum now matches aaaa1111 at 10:24:30Z. healthcheck passed.

sam: ok we can roll traffic back gradually. maria, rollback route change in 3 steps: 20%, 50%, 100% over next 5 mins. watch error-rate and latency.

maria: started 20% -> received ack.

ops-bot: metric updates: 20% shift error-rate 4.8%, 50% shift error-rate 2.6%, 100% shift error-rate 2.2% (within SLO).

sam: post-mitigation notes: root cause likely partial propagation due to transient dp-agent-2 artifact download failure causing it to serve a stale/broken variant (v2a). control plane marked rollout complete because config-store acked — but ack didn't guarantee artifact pull.

lee: follow-ups for RCA: - add stronger propagation ack semantics (require n/majority agents report artifact checksum) - surface agent artifact checksum in console per-region - add deploy step that verifies artifact at least on first 3 agents before marking rollout complete - improve monitoring for model-id header mismatch.

anita: logging bundle and timeline uploaded to the incident folder. I'll start draft of post-incident timeline and assign RCA owners.

sam: nice work. marking incident mitigated at 10:26:40Z. we'll keep thread open for RCA until tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

maria: adding follow-up tickets now: PROD-8471 (propagation ack), PROD-8472 (console checksum), PROD-8473 (deploy verification).

sam: thanks everyone. closing bridge but keep channel pinned for updates.
